content.rendered:
Every volunteer in Sherwood School District must have a criminal background check completed on a yearly basis (once per school year).  It takes approximately 2-3 business days to complete the process, so if you would like to volunteer for a field trip or other event, please plan ahead!  

You only need to submit your information one time per school year.  Once it has cleared, your name will be added to the master list for all locations. If you have an out of state drivers license there may be a need for additional information. If this is the case, you will be notified by mail.   

We encourage you to connect with the LRMS PAC around volunteer opportunities.
